upsert.title: BIOCERA-VET injectable bone cement for canine appendicular osteosarcoma
upsert.location: Oniris Veterinary Teaching Hospital, Nantes, France
upsert.intervention: Minimally invasive percutaneous injection of BIOCERA-VET calcium-phosphate bone cement into the osteosarcoma-affected bone under fluoroscopic guidance; limb-preserving palliative treatment.
upsert.eligibility_summary: Large- or giant-breed dogs with appendicular osteosarcoma diagnosed by imaging; bone biopsy may be performed if diagnosis is uncertain.
upsert.notes: Primary Oniris page explicitly states recruitment is currently open and describes a prospective multicenter clinical study with TheraVet. Initial protocol visit is covered. Treatment is palliative but directly treats/stabilizes the tumor-bearing bone and is therefore included under the treatment-focused scope.
